note: Every public source found for com.facebook.katana, com.facebook.orca and com.facebook.lite, with the branches and commits it was last read at, its licence and what Hushfacebook may take from it. scripts/facebook-sources.ps1 holds it to its rules, scripts/audit-facebook-sources.ps1 refreshes it, and a local release needs a census from the last 14 days. docs/sources.md is the readable version.

entries.reason: The maintained Facebook source and Hushfacebook's primary upstream. Its anchors hold across Facebook's renames, its patches fail loudly at patch time, and most of the shipped patches were rewritten from its commit 5db2e57e. The bundle also patches LINE, so only its Facebook, shared and extension code is watched.

GPL-3.0 and the most features for Facebook 573, several only on its dev branch. It hardcodes 573's obfuscated names, so its ideas and anchors are what carries over. The feed filter credits its PROMOTION rule.
A GPL-3.0 fork of Froggo that adds suggested-post filtering and a Following-feed home for 573.
A GPL-3.0 copy of Froggo's Facebook 573 patches inside a multi-app bundle, with the clearest current 11-patch source and a Material You resource map. Only its Facebook folder is watched.
An archived GPL-3.0 fork of Froggo that records a reworked downloader for 573.

entries.reason: Two ZIP archives of Facebook 573 download sources and no licence at the root. Useful only to compare downloader behavior, and nothing in it can be ported.

The original GPL-3.0 Facebook pair, still pinned to 490, and the four Messenger patches most Messenger work descends from. Its GitHub home is blocked by a DMCA notice, so GitLab holds it for now. It's ancestry and regression evidence for Facebook, and the likely base for a Messenger sibling.

entries.reason: A personal ReVanced copy whose main is ReVanced's main commit for commit. Its dev branch carries unmerged Messenger Meta AI work and the finding that Messenger 564 moved onCreate into an obfuscated superclass.

entries.reason: The ReVanced Facebook pair and eight GPL-3.0 Messenger patches with exact-version pins, in a multi-app bundle. A base for the Messenger sibling.

features: Hide inbox stories and notes tray
entries.reason: The largest GPL-3.0 Messenger set, inside a 278-patch multi-app bundle. Screen capture in encrypted chats and the screenshot-detection bypass change what other people are told, so they would not ship by default.

mirrors.reason: An older copy of rushiranpise's Messenger patches, pinned to Messenger 573. The Morphe Patch Tracker lists it under the vomw name with rushiranpise's address.

entries.reason: Its only Facebook patch is labelled STUB and does nothing.

entries.reason: Named for Facebook but still the unmodified Morphe patches template.

features: Block ads (feed sponsored units, video ads, banners)
entries.reason: The widest map of Facebook's ad pipelines, with no licence. Its README is read for ideas and stable strings, and its code never is. Session export and the ad-free session spoof are out anyway.
A copy of FacebookAppAdsRemover with Facebook 577 Reels and commercial-break paths written down. No licence, so its notes are hypotheses for fixture work and nothing more.

GPL-3.0 at the repository level, but its Facebook master patch says it ports every FacebookAppAdsRemover hook, and that code has no licence. The Facebook subtree is behavior-only until Loukious licenses it.
Claims buildable source, but holds only a README and a licence. Its list of ad surfaces corroborates demand and nothing else.
MIT-licensed Messenger hooks for inbox ads, Meta AI and the browser. A reference for the Messenger sibling, though Xposed itself is not coming here.

features: Remove AI, Reels, Events and Chat moments menu surfaces
entries.reason: An MIT update of MessengerEx for April 2026 Messenger, with a structural precheck report worth copying into a fixture-first sibling.
No licence. Its notes on rewriting the two signature permissions so Messenger installs beside Facebook are useful evidence. Anti-seen and the unsent-message logger are out.
No licence, and unchanged since January 2024. Demand evidence for file handling and conversation lock.
No licence, and it hands out patched Messenger and Facebook APKs. Nothing to take.
The only Facebook Lite Morphe patch found. It opens links in your own browser, on any version. It lives on the dev branch of a multi-app bundle, so only its Lite folder is watched.

features: Injected overlay into a rebuilt Facebook Lite APK
entries.reason: Publishes a rebuilt Meta APK with cookie extraction and account automation, and has no licence. Nothing here fits Hushfacebook.

features: One-tap video download from Facebook Lite
entries.reason: A GPL-3.0 multi-app video downloader whose Facebook and Facebook Lite hooks date from 2018, far too old to anchor anything in 577 or 580. Only its Facebook module is watched.

features: Unlock Meta Plus benefits and custom app icons
entries.reason: Unlocks the paid Meta Plus subscription, which Hushfacebook leaves out as a paywall bypass, and has no licence.
